Vendor._comment: DailyRunTimeUtc is when ShkrVendorService runs its once-a-day sync. ConnectionString moved to the shared "Database" section 2026-09-04 - see there.

Database._comment: ConnectionString is a PLACEHOLDER - set the real PMWeb SQL Server connection string via User Secrets/environment, never commit it here. Shared by every SQL consumer in this project (Vendor, Project, SqlServerHealthCheck) - not owned by any one of them.

FileLogging._comment: Path is a relative dev-friendly default (rolling daily file, 30-day retention, see Program.cs). Override with the real absolute production log folder via appsettings.Production.json or environment - don't commit a real server path here.
